name: player_select_alt_gun_fire_origin_and_slot
description: Player::SelectAltGunFirePointAndSlot selects the alt-fire origin and active fire slot for fallback, center, right, and left hardpoint states.
known_limits: Binary Ninja assembly/HLIL inspection in the current session verified the fallback path when gunNode or turretNode is missing, the ComposeAimBasisWorldMatrix dependency, center attachState behavior, right/left hardpoint transforms, slot attach-node writes, outActiveFireSlotPtr writes, and altHardpointSelectState 1/2 oscillation.
The native smoke checks fallback worldPos+1 aim/origin, center normal transform, center attachState direct origin, right-slot selection with state advance, and left-slot selection with state advance.
The original body uses x87-heavy point transforms; no VC object-byte manifest covers 0x43aa30 yet, so tier S verification is deferred to the player aim/source-cluster pass.
